name: PDM-35
summary: 2-Phenyl-3,5-dimethylmorpholine is a drug with stimulant and anorectic effects, related to phenmetrazine. Based on what is known from other phenylmorpholines with similar structure, it likely acts as a norepinephrine-dopamine releasing agent and may produce effects similar or slightly different to phenmetrazine.

pharmacology.text: Based on what is known from other phenylmorpholines with similar structure, it likely acts as a norepinephrine-dopamine releasing agent and may produce effects similar or slightly different to phenmetrazine.

uses.en: It has no medical use and is known from the chemical literature on stimulants.
uses.zh: 它沒有醫療用途，見於興奮劑的化學文獻中。
uses.zhHans: 它没有医疗用途，见于兴奋剂的化学文献中。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the stimulants, can cause a fast heart rate, raised blood pressure, overheating, anxiety, sleeplessness and, with repeated use, dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的興奮劑類藥物，可能引起心跳加快、血壓上升、體溫過高、焦慮、失眠，反覆使用還可能導致成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的兴奋剂类药物，可能引起心跳加快、血压上升、体温过高、焦虑、失眠，反复使用还可能导致成瘾。

fact.en: It belongs to the phenylmorpholines, the family of phenmetrazine, a diet pill of the 1950s and 1960s, and of the later antidepressant bupropion's cousin phenmetrazine analogues.
fact.zh: 它屬於苯基嗎啉類，與 1950 至 1960 年代的減肥藥芬美曲秦同一家族。
fact.zhHans: 它属于苯基吗啉类，与 1950 至 1960 年代的减肥药芬美曲秦同一家族。
